recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up studio portrait of a young man with styled hair, positioned on the left, balanced by a dense column of right-aligned typography on a warm, neutral background.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject gaze directed slightly off-camera to the left
Text block anchored to the right vertical third
Color harmony between the subject's tan jacket and the warm sepia-toned background
Contrast between the dark, heavy display type and the light, airy body text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the left two-thirds of the frame, scaled from chest to top of head.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's blue eyes provide the primary focal point, followed by the large black display text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the subject's face to the large title in the upper right, then down the list of tracks.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space on the right side is utilized for typographic information.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm tan and ochre tones in the jacket and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for the primary display typography.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pale white/cream for the secondary tracklist text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the black text and the light background.

letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight for display text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying weights and colors of the same condensed sans-serif family.

preserve: Color contrast between title and list

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed feel of the primary display text.
Appropriate for the secondary uppercase tracklist.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 1960s-style studio portrait of a young man with a pompadour hairstyle wearing a tan blazer. The lighting should be soft and warm. The subject should be positioned on the left side of the frame against a mottled, warm-toned neutral background, leaving the right side empty.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a column of right-aligned text in the right-hand negative space. Use a heavy, black, condensed sans-serif for the main title at the top. Below it, add a list of items in a smaller, white, condensed sans-serif, all in uppercase with generous line spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the subject positioned to the left?
Are the colors warm and desaturated?
Is the primary font a heavy condensed sans-serif?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not overlap the subject's face
Verify the right-alignment of the text column
Confirm the color palette remains in the warm earth-tone range
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio portrait on left + right-aligned condensed sans-serif typography + warm vintage color grading.
